footerDescription: Transfer files over your local network; share clipboard text across networks with optional Cloud Sync.
productScope: New users get a one-time free transfer allowance to try every feature. After that, WinSend Pro unlocks all features with a one-time purchase and no usage limits; the current price is shown in the app. Files and photos require a reachable local network. Cloud Sync needs internet and supports clipboard text only. Automatic sync does not bypass iOS background or clipboard restrictions. Shortcuts require iOS 16+ and must be triggered. WinSend is an AirDrop-style alternative, not Apple AirDrop. WinSend does not deliberately compress transferred files; source apps or system export may change their representation, and device/network/storage limits still apply.
